name: Corpse Swarm
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (the dried exoskeleton of an insect)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one corpse or corporeal undead
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Fort negates (object); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You summon a number of cockroach swarms (one per three levels, to a maximum of six swarms at 18th level) to erupt from the corpse touched. Each swarm ignores you but attacks other living creatures nearby. The swarms are not otherwise under your control. You may target a specific corpse only once with this spell.
